scope: Targeted retrospective review of this conversation's uncommitted .NET changes against relevant C# history and tests; not an exhaustive audit of every project commit or proof of whole-game parity.
prior_work_limitation: Earlier work checked current C# code and tests but did not systematically inspect history for every affected flow. This review followed the user's warning that native/C# differences may be deliberate fixes.

reviewed_history.change: Movement skills and stale fall-damage rejection
reviewed_history.result: Movement implementation and fall-damage handler match HEAD. New channel loading retains their map/channel and movement checks.

reviewed_history.change: NPC quests, crafting and quest-object pickup
reviewed_history.result: NPC handler matches HEAD. Eligibility, pickup/payment checks and validation before ingredient spending remain.

reviewed_history.change: Authenticated Map entry and service links
reviewed_history.result: Main-entry, ENTERCHAR and ValidateEntryAsync handlers match HEAD; production authentication and TLS/admin separation remain.
Both implementation files match HEAD. Exit still releases reservations and channel changes reject private rooms.
Summon power/defence helpers match HEAD. Owner credit, target types and fake hits remain; common monster damage uses the same defence helpers.
Buffed getters, immunity gates and damage-layer hooks remain in the typed damage path.

reviewed_history.change: Buff erasure, dispel and summon damage sharing
reviewed_history.result: DistributeSkill matches HEAD. Existing share, erasure and dispel calls remain; defensive reactions follow the shared damage calculation.
Map/channel gates remain; cast authorization adds ownership constraints.
CancelAi matches HEAD: HostKey invalidation, without rebuilding the queue.
LearnedSkill and IsLearned match HEAD; MaxLevel == 0 remains usable while ordinary unlearned placeholders are rejected.

reviewed_history.change: Monster hit occurs at landed report
reviewed_history.result: Announce/report timing remains. The separate client-power echo contract is deliberately changed as documented below.

reviewed_history.change: Loot-window locks, hunter and lock release
reviewed_history.result: Window and lock-release handlers match HEAD. Access restrictions extend to direct requests.
The review found the new party-money/access rules missing from this separate path. It now uses shared money distribution and access checks, retaining trade, capacity and item-owner checks.

intentional_legacy_test_changes.reason: Prevent forged attacker credit while preserving packet layout.
Authoritative power; existing landed-report timing remains.

intentional_legacy_test_changes.after: Entering until World grants the destination
intentional_legacy_test_changes.reason: Prevent premature CONREADY from bypassing routing/loading.

audit_corrections: Share level-weighted money distribution between the separate request and take-all.
Apply map/channel, hunter and inventory-lock checks to take-all.
Retain the earlier take-all trade gate and enforce it on separate item/money requests.
Record mandatory history-preservation checks in AGENTS.md.

validation.platform: Isolated Linux .NET 10 SDK container; source and host NuGet cache mounted read-only

remaining_limits: This bounded review does not certify every earlier C# fix or every interaction.
Broader loot routing modes, original-client playthroughs, real restart persistence and publisher parity require separate verification.
